author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0099638 endosome to plasma membrane protein transport, and its regulation children,
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31237

All four terms are obsoleted **with direct replacements**:

| obsoleted | replaced_by |
|---|---|
| GO:0099638 endosome to plasma membrane protein transport | GO:0032456 endocytic recycling |
| GO:1905749 regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport | GO:2001135 regulation of endocytic recycling |
| GO:1905750 negative regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport | GO:2001136 negative regulation of endocytic recycling |
| GO:1905751 positive regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport | GO:2001137 positive regulation of endocytic recycling |

The reason for obsoletion is that GO:0099638 duplicated GO:0032456, differing only by a protein cargo restriction that GO:0032456's logical definition does not carry; the reasoner already classified GO:0099638 under it. The regulation children follow necessarily, since with the regulated process gone they become logically equivalent to the endocytic recycling regulation terms.

The replacement is a generalisation in every case, so an annotation valid for an obsoleted term remains valid for its replacement. No annotation should need to be removed; groups may still want to check whether a more specific term now fits better.

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18WIGl22_gHer7IbzhjuLPsihANWvztObwNPM8Kynh9E

Pending that, the full list of 36 experimental annotations (21 unique PMIDs) is inline below.

author: ValWood
body:
It should be 

endocytic recycling replaced by
GO:0099638 endosome to plasma membrane protein transport 

this would fit the existing definitions, and should therefor fit the annotations.

Ideally we would have obsoleted 
endocytic recycling  and kept
GO:0099638 endosome to plasma membrane protein transport 
but relabelling the retained term will have the equivalent effect

However  "endocytic recycling" should be a "~broad synonym~" narrow synonym of "endosome to plasma membrane protein transport "
rather than exact
~becasue although the term endocytic recycling was only defined as 'endosome to plasma membrane transport' step it should also include internalization if it was defined correctly~.

@raymond91125  @pgaudet  does this make sense?

author: ValWood
body:
Correction:
The "endocytic recycling" term does refer only to the return leg.
However "GO:0099638 endosome to plasma membrane protein transport" is broader (becasue not all " endosome to plasma membrane protein transport" is considered recycling.

The outcome id the same, the primary name to retain  is "GO:0099638 endosome to plasma membrane protein transport"
and this should fit all annotations  to both terms.

relabelling and adding a synonym will fix. "fast endocytic recycling" and "slow endocytic recycling"  can still sit under  "GO:0099638 endosome to plasma membrane protein transport"

author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Update for reviewers: following go-ontology#31237, the replacement terms have been relabelled (geneontology/go-ontology#32751, merged). The IDs are unchanged.

| obsoleted | replaced_by (new label) |
|---|---|
| GO:0099638 (endosome to plasma membrane protein transport) | GO:0032456 (endosome to plasma membrane transport), formerly "endocytic recycling" |
| GO:1905749 (regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport) | GO:2001135 (regulation of endosome to plasma membrane transport) |
| GO:1905750 (negative regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport) | GO:2001136 (negative regulation of endosome to plasma membrane transport) |
| GO:1905751 (positive regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport) | GO:2001137 (positive regulation of endosome to plasma membrane transport) |

GO:0032456 (endosome to plasma membrane transport) now covers all vesicle-mediated transport from endosomes to the plasma membrane, so it fits annotations made to either old term. This implements @ValWood's suggestion above. GO:0032457 (fast endocytic recycling) and GO:0032458 (slow endocytic recycling) are still available where recycling specifically is shown.
